newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron drops 6.06 pct on peso jitters.
newsitem.headline: Petron drops 6.06 pct on peso jitters.

text.p: The Philippine's biggest oil refiner Petron Corp dropped 40 centavos, or 6.06 percent, to 6.20 pesos in early trade on fears that it would be adversely affected by the weakened peso, brokers said.
"The company will have to pay more for crude oil imports with the depreciation of the peso," said Cilette Liboro, research head at Orion-Squire Capital.
A peso depreciation will translate to higher landed cost of crude and bigger foreign exchange risk exposure for local oil refiners.
Petron spokeswoman Malou Erni said the company has no statement yet on the effect of the peso depreciation on its earning prospects.
Petron was among the top 10 most heavily traded shares by midsession.
